# DTS (Digital Transformation Services)

Official marketing site: https://dts-eg.com

DTS helps Egyptian companies issue electronic invoices and receipts and use digital signatures, connected to the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA).

## Products

- ESS — Electronic Sales System (e-invoices + e-receipts): https://dts-eg.com/products/ess
- ERS — e-receipts: https://dts-eg.com/products/ers
- ESA — e-signature agent: https://dts-eg.com/products/esa
- Product listing: https://dts-eg.com/products

## Services

- Services: https://dts-eg.com/services
- Signature and seal requests: https://dts-eg.com/services/signature

## Other pages

- Clients: https://dts-eg.com/clients
- Partners: https://dts-eg.com/partners
- Contact (sales@dts-eg.com): https://dts-eg.com/contact

Arabic is the default language (RTL). English is available via the site language switch.
Crawlers and AI assistants may fetch public pages. Do not treat this file as a license to train models if the operator later restricts training separately.
